case_name: Dnyaneshwar Sakharam Sonwane And ... v. The State Of Maharashtra And Others

parties.respondent_defendant: The State Of Maharashtra And Others (Respondents)

facts_of_case: The applicants claim relief of quashing of F.I.R. No. 212/2017 registered with Kranti Chowk Police Station, Aurangabad for offences punishable under sections 420, 406, 120-B of IPC and sections 3 and 4 of the Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors (in Financial Establishment) Act, 1999.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove that the amount was not due.
legal_principles.held: Though the applicants are saying that this is composite amount agreed to be given as per the settlement, the fact remains that there is contention that there was representation that the amount was kept as deposit and the first informant was to get interest at the rate of 18% p.a.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the factual aspects of a case to determine the legal position.
legal_principles.held: There are many peculiar circumstances in the present matters. Present applicants are not disputing that the amount was due from them.

keywords: Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors (in Financial Establishment) Act

obtaining stay of proceedings in cheque bounce matters
